svg.title: PB-MO-005 stack mould CNC machining diagram
svg.text: SECTION THROUGH PIN AND BOLT (1:1, SCHEMATIC)
DOWEL PIN Ø6 m6, PRESSED IN THE FIXTURE
TOOL LIST (H = T; STEP-DOWN / STEP-OVER IN THE PROGRAM HEADERS)
D10 3FL CARBIDE END MILL, LOC 32 (LONG), ALU
CLAMP PLATES CLEARING, PROFILES, FIXTURE RELIEF
D8 3FL CARBIDE END MILL, LOC 20, ALU
D6 3FL CARBIDE END MILL, LOC 16, ALU
FLOORS, SEAT FACES, CAVITY WALL, NOTCHES
TAPERED END MILL 1.5 DEG/SIDE, TIP D3 FLAT, LOC
T2 T7 T11 T12 T9 T10 T1
MAIN PLATE - OP 10 DRILL AND REAM
CLAMP PLATES (TOP + BOTTOM) - OP 10 DRILL AN
MAIN PLATE - OP 30 FACE B (HYBRID) + PROFILE
T2 T3 T4 T5 T6 T1
TOP CLAMP PLATE - OP 20 TEETH + PROFILE
BOTTOM CLAMP PLATE - OP 20 TEETH + PROFILE
SIMULATION CHECK (0.25 mm STOCK MODEL vs MOULD STL)
GOUGE / LEFT: LARGEST DEVIATION FROM THE CAD OUTSIDE THE BY-DESIGN FEATURES (mm, TOLERANCE ±0.03 AT 0.25 mm CELLS);
R3 = TOOL RADIUS IN THE CAVITY CORNERS AT THE BUTT AND IN THE NOTCH CORNERS; CHAMFERS 0.4 × 45° ON THE UNMACHINED PARTING FACE.
SIMULATED: O0110 + O0120 ON THE MAIN PLATE (FACE A)
MACHINE: 3-AXIS VMC, X ≥ 500, Y ≥ 300 TRAVEL, 10 000 rpm, FLOOD COOLANT (ISO PROGRAMS, output/cnc/iso). ROUTER WITH A 24k
SPINDLE: output/cnc/generic, ONE FILE PER TOOL, MIST / AIR BLAST. FEEDS ARE STARTING VALUES – PROVE THEM ON SCRAP.
G54: PROBE THE 2 DOWEL PINS; X0 Y0 LIES 332.17 IN -X FROM THEIR MID-POINT, ON THEIR CENTRE LINE. Z0 ON THE STOCK TOP.
TOOL LENGTHS IN H1-H12 (ISO). GENERIC FILES: TOUCH EACH TOOL OFF AT Z0 BEFORE ITS FILE.
CLEARANCE Z30, LINKS AT Z3 (Z12 WHERE A LINK PASSES A BOLT HEAD). MINIMUM STICK-OUTS IN THE TOOL LIST CLEAR THE BOLT
HEADS AND CLAMPS. KEEP THE TOE CLAMPS ON THE MARKED WASTE ZONES; NOTHING ELSE MAY STAND ON THE BLANK.
OP 30 AND THE CLAMP PROFILES CUT THROUGH: THE WASTE STAYS UNDER THE TOE CLAMPS, THE PLATE ON ITS BOLTS. CLAMP PLATES:
M0 BEFORE THE PROFILE – FIT THE 18 BOLTS (M6 × 25) THROUGH THE FINISHED FLANGE.
FIXTURE (BLIND HOLES, IT LIES ON THE TABLE): TAP 18 × M6 AND 6 × M10, 15 DEEP, BY HAND OR RIGID TAP; PINS Ø6 × 20 PRESSED
12 DEEP. THE T2 RELIEF BORES PLUNGE 4 mm BY DESIGN. THE FIXTURE STAYS ON THE TABLE FOR ALL SET-UPS.
SIMULATION (tools/verify_cnc.py): EVERY PROGRAM RUN ON A 0.25 mm STOCK MODEL AGAINST THE MOULD STLs – NO RAPID INTO
STOCK, NO FLUTE OVERRUN, NO OBSTACLE HIT; DEVIATIONS ONLY WHERE NOTED IN THE CHECK TABLE.
AFTER MACHINING: DEBURR, POLISH THE CAVITIES AND TEETH (PB-MO-004 NOTE 6), DRY-FIT THE STACK ON THE 2 PINS WITH THE
TRIAL RIB SUPPORTS, THEN SEAL AND WAX AS PB-MO-003.
FIXTURE · DRILL · MAIN PLATE FACES A + B · CLAMP PLATES · ISO + GENERIC PROGRAMS · SIMULATED
